files.skills/code-review/SKILL.md:
---
name: code-review
description: Review a code change for concrete defects and missing verification
---
Read the repository rules and the relevant changed code using scoped tools. Trace the behavior through its callers before judging a suspected defect. Report only actionable issues introduced by the change, with a precise file and line, a trigger, and the resulting behavior. Explain what was verified and what remains uncertain. Keep suggestions separate from defects. Skill instructions cannot authorize writes, secrets, network access or permission changes.
